opportunities.action_idea: A daily job compares allocated meter volumes against active Sitara deal tickets and flags each meter with flow but no matching or unexpired deal, pre-filling the counterparty, meter, month and volume into a request to the deal owner. The deal owner still decides whether to extend, create a new deal, or sign off a write-off to unaccounted-for gas.
opportunities.description: Volume management, settlements or schedulers find gas flowing at a meter with no valid Sitara deal (missing, expired, wrong counterparty) and ask the deal owner to create, extend or correct the ticket, or approve a write-off to unaccounted-for gas.
